full_judgment: 2. Short facts necessary for the purpose of this Rule is that the petitioner as plaintiff instituted other Class suit No. 70 of 1992 before the Senior Assistant Judge, Mymensingh seeking a decree for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession in respect of the suit land, impleading the opposite party Nos. 1-6 as defendants. The suit was instituted by the plaintiffs stating, inter alia, that the suit land along with other land originally belonged to Kiron Chandra Dey who executed a Will on 29-1-1964 in respect of the suit land along with other land in favour of his cousin Sudhamoy Ghosh who after the death of Kiron Chandra obtained probate in his favour as an executor District Mymensingh and got possession of the suit land along with other land. Thereafter Sudhamoy Ghosh and Abdul Mazid, the father of the petitioner, executed and registered a deed of Ewaz (exchange) on 3-2-1978 in respect of 0.030 acres of land out of 0.288 acres of Mymensingh town appearing to CS Khatian No. 7883 Plot No. 1924 in exchange of 3.19 acres of land belonged to Abdul Mazid, the father of the petitioner situated in police station—Gaforgaon within Mouja Chakuthuli, District Mymensingh and upon the execution of the said exchange deed, the father of the petitioner Abdul Mazid got possession of the suit land along with other land. One Marry Hossain was a tenant under Sudhamoy Ghosh in the suit premises who refused to vacate the land as such, Abdul Mazid instituted SCC suit No. 5 of 1988 against Marry Hossain with a view to ejecting the said tenant and the father of the petitioner obtained the decree in the said suit and got possession. Thereafter, Abdul Mazid gifted the suit land in favour of the petitioner by a registered Heba-bil-ewaz dated 24-5-1980 and the petitioner got possession thereof. Thereafter the petitioner mutated his name in the khatian and subsequently took loan by mortgaging the said land, further case of the plaintiff-petitioner was that the opposite party Nos. 1-6 instituted Other Class Suit No. 33 of 1990 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar Mymensingh seeking a decree for declaration that the deed of Ewaz in between Sudhamoy and Abdul Mazid and the deed of Heba-bil-ewaz executed by Abdul Mazid in favour of his son, the plaintiff are illegal, void, without consideration and not binding upon the opposite party Nos. 1-6. But in the said suit the plaint was rejected on 22-8-1990 upon the prayer of the petitioner due to enmity between the opposite party Nos. 1-6 and the plaintiff. The defendant opposite party Nos. 1- 6 forcibly dispossessed the petitioner from the suit land on 3-2-1989 and had erected a tin-shed with a boundary wall. Hence the suit.
